title: DataFrame __getitem__ ~100X slower on Pandas 0.19.1 vs 0.18.1 possibly getitem caching?

labels.name: Indexing
labels.description: Related to indexing on series/frames, not to indexes themselves

labels.name: Regression
labels.description: Functionality that used to work in a prior pandas version

body:

# Run on Pandas 0.19.1

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame(np.random.randn(1000,5000), columns=['C'+str(c) for c in range(5000)])

#### Problem description

It appears that ```get_item_cache()``` or ```__contains__``` may have something to do with it. This affects other functionality such as ```df.info()``` which is now also ~100X slower.
